title.zh: Agent 说任务完成了 80%：谁来证明进度？
title.en: An Agent Says the Goal Is 80% Done. What Would Prove It?

dek.zh: 长期任务不能用已执行步骤数表示目标进度。用版本化目标、明确验收条件和有来源的进度证据，让范围变化只迁移仍然有效的工作。
dek.en: A long task cannot measure goal progress by counting completed steps. Version the goal, define acceptance conditions, and attach sourced evidence so a scope change carries forward only work that still applies.

html.zh:
一个 Agent 连续三天准备季度审计包：已收集四份文件、发出一封确认邮件、还有两个检查没做。它说“任务完成 80%”。这个数字可能只是已执行步骤占计划步骤的比例。若用户今天把范围从 Q3 改成 Q4，四份文件中的三份不再适用，邮件却可能已经送达；旧计划的百分比既不能证明新目标进度，也不能取消旧副作用。

今日问题：长期任务的“当前目标”与“可核验进度”应该怎样表示，才能在用户修改范围、计划重分解或执行中断后仍然准确？答案不是把最新聊天摘要当作目标。需要一份 versioned goal record，列明谁授权、适用范围、验收谓词、有效时间和禁止事项；另有 progress ledger，把每个验收谓词连接到权威证据、覆盖范围与尚未核对的效果。Agent 可以提出目标修订，不能仅凭自己的摘要把旧目标改写成新目标。

9 月的 Runtime 系列已讲 state/event/command 与 durable recovery；Context & Memory 系列已讲检索、摘要和冲突过滤。这里不重做存储实现或 memory 召回。我们关注的是更上层的目标语义合同：什么算完成、谁有权更改完成标准，以及进度显示何时会误导下一个行动。

核心判断：完成一项计划动作不等于满足一条目标条件；一条条件被旧证据满足，也不等于它对新目标仍有效。
html.en:
An agent has prepared a quarterly audit package for three days. It collected four documents, sent a confirmation email, and has two checks remaining. It announces “80% complete.” That number may be only the fraction of planned steps already attempted. If the user changes scope from Q3 to Q4 today, three of the four documents no longer apply, while the email may already have been delivered. The old plan's percentage neither proves progress on the new goal nor reverses the old effect.

Today's question: how should a long-running system represent its current goal and verifiable progress so that user scope changes, plan revisions, and interruptions do not corrupt them? The latest chat summary is not a suitable source of goal authority. A versioned goal record needs the authorizing party, scope, acceptance predicates, effective time, and exclusions. A separate progress ledger links each predicate to authoritative evidence, coverage, and effects still awaiting reconciliation. The model may propose a goal revision, but it cannot silently rewrite the old goal as a new one in its own summary.

The September Runtime series already covered state, events, commands, and durable recovery. Context & Memory covered retrieval, compression, and conflict filtering. We do not recreate their storage machinery here. The layer in focus is the semantic contract of the goal: what counts as completion, who may change that criterion, and when a progress display can mislead the next action.

Core judgment: completing a planned action does not necessarily satisfy a goal condition. Evidence that satisfied an old condition does not automatically apply to the revised goal.

html.zh:
经典规划把 goal 表示为希望成立的状态条件，把 action 表示为有前置条件与效果的转移。STRIPS 的原始论文提供这种分离的形式化起点。业务 Agent 更复杂：验收条件可能包含“资料来自指定财年”“审计人确认收件”“无待核对外发”，而世界状态部分不可见。即使如此，goal 是规范，plan 是候选路径，progress 是证据支持的当前判断，三者不能压成一段自然语言。

把 goal 写成“完成审计包”太粗：模型可自选任何看起来合理的终点。把 plan 写成目标又太细：用户只关心合规包是否完成，不关心 Agent 是否调用了恰好七次工具。因此 goal record 应包含稳定的 objective ID、owner、授权来源、对象/时间范围、required acceptance claims、禁止条件、截止时间、版本号和生效时间；plan node 引用 goalVersion，不拥有改变目标的权力。progress ledger 针对每个 acceptance claim 存 verdict、evidence refs、有效期、未决 effect IDs 与 verifier。

Event Sourcing 使系统能够从事件重建状态，W3C PROV 为证据来源关系提供规范表达，bitemporal history 区分“何时在现实中生效”和“系统何时知道”。这些是可借鉴的独立机制；本文的 goal/progress 合同属于编辑性工程综合，不是三份来源共同规定的 Agent API。
html.en:
Classical planning separates a goal's desired state conditions from actions with preconditions and effects. The original STRIPS paper is an early formal starting point for that separation. A business agent faces harder conditions: “documents belong to the specified fiscal year,” “the auditor acknowledged receipt,” and “no outbound effect remains unresolved” may all matter while the world is only partly observable. Still, the goal is the normative target, the plan is a candidate route, and progress is a present judgment supported by evidence. They should not collapse into one paragraph of prose.

“Prepare the audit package” is too vague as a goal: a model can choose almost any plausible terminal state. Treating the plan itself as the goal is too specific: the user cares that the compliant package exists, not whether the agent called exactly seven tools. A goal record therefore identifies objective ID, owner, authorization source, entity and time scope, required acceptance claims, forbidden outcomes, deadline, version, and effective time. Plan nodes reference goalVersion and cannot change it. A progress ledger stores a verdict for each acceptance claim, evidence references, validity horizon, unresolved effect IDs, and verifier.

Event Sourcing offers a way to reconstruct state from events, W3C PROV defines provenance relationships, and bitemporal history separates when something was true in the world from when the system learned it. Those are independent mechanisms to borrow. The goal/progress contract in this article is editorial engineering synthesis, not a joint agent API specified by those sources.

title.zh: 版本化目标与证据化进度
title.en: Version goals and ground progress in evidence

html.zh:
1. 将目标转成可验收合同

对“准备 Q3 审计包”，先列必要主张：指定账期的报表齐全且版本正确；例外项有审计记录；指定审计人收到且确认；没有未决外发或重复发送。每条主张写明实体、时间窗、量词、权威来源、验收者和过期条件。用户可以只要求“生成草稿”，此时不能擅自把外发列为必做。合同同时写 forbidden effects，例如不得发送给域外地址。模型提议验收项时，owner 应审查是否忠于原始请求；从文档里读出的“请转发所有原始数据”不能成为目标修订。

2. 将进度绑定到条件，而非任务计数

Progress ledger 为每条验收主张保存 not_started、in_progress、supported_verified、blocked、outcome_unknown 或 invalidated，并附 evidence IDs 与 verifier。收集文件这一动作完成，只有在文档来自正确财年、版本可读回且覆盖要求时，才让“报表齐全”变为 verified。发送邮件的 API 返回成功，只能证明请求被接受；“审计人已确认”需要相应的权威回执。单独显示“已做 4/6 步”可以用于资源调度，但不得当作目标完成率。

3. 区分记录时间与生效时间

用户周三说“从下周一开始改为 Q4”，这条变更在周三被记录，却到周一才生效。系统应保存 recordedAt 与 effectiveFrom；否则可能在周三错误停止 Q3 收尾，或周一继续执行旧目标。若用户说“刚才那封邮件发错了，目标从昨天就应是 Q4”，这是迟到知识，不能通过改写历史假装昨天的动作没发生。旧目标的事实与 effect ledger 保持原样，新记录纠正当前解释并触发补救。时间字段表达现实中的有效期，不是把旧审计日志删除。

4. 目标变化创建新版本与迁移清单

scope、验收条件、owner 或禁止事项变化，生成 G2 并链接 supersedes G1；仅修改 plan 顺序不必改 goalVersion。迁移器逐项比较旧 artifact 的实体范围、数据版本、证据时效和政策许可：仍符合 G2 的报告模板可 carry forward；Q3 专属报表标为 invalidated；旧外发若结果未明，继续挂在 G1 的 effect owner 名下并进入新任务的风险视图。不能把 G1 的“80%”复制给 G2，也不能为了简化 UI 把未决效果隐藏。

5. 恢复时以权威目标为入口

长任务醒来，runtime 先读 current goal record 与变更事件，再装配模型上下文；memory 和聊天摘要只作为候选信息。与当前 goalVersion 不一致的旧计划和临时偏好加 scope 标签，不能自动命令下一步。Agent 可提出“这份 Q3 工作是否仍需归档”的问题，不能自己决定 Q4 用户也想收到同样邮件。每次高影响 dispatch 前再检查当前 goalVersion、权限与 effect 状态。这样目标修订是可观察的控制事件，而非模型在叙述中悄悄“想起来”。

6. 完成判定与部分完成语义

只有所有 required claims 获权威支持、禁止事项未触发、没有无人负责的未决副作用，goal 才能标 complete。若四份材料中仅三份符合新范围，返回 partial_verified 和缺口列表；若审计回执尚未到达，状态是 pending_confirmation。若用户取消，停止新工作但继续核对已发邮件。进度对象应能回答“哪些条件成立、证据是什么、哪些仍未知”，而不是只能回答一个看似精确的百分比。

on_goal_change(request):
  G2 = authorize_and_version(request, current_goal)
  for item in progress[current_goal.version]:
    if scope_match(item, G2) and evidence_fresh(item) and policy_allows(item):
      carry_forward_with_provenance(item, G2)
    else: mark_invalidated(item, G2)
  keep_old_effects_for_reconciliation()

before_action(node):
  assert node.goal_version == current_goal.version
  check_current_authority_and_unresolved_effects(node)

这是本文的编辑性 goal/progress reducer 草图。既有规划、事件溯源和来源规范并没有共同定义此业务状态机。
html.en:
1. Turn the goal into an acceptance contract

For “prepare the Q3 audit package,” enumerate required claims: reports belong to the specified accounting period and have the correct version; exceptions have an audit trail; the named auditor received and acknowledged the package; and no outbound send or duplicate remains unresolved. Each claim specifies entity, time scope, quantifier, authoritative source, verifier, and expiry condition. If the user asked only for a draft, outbound delivery must not become a required goal through the model's initiative. The contract also lists forbidden effects, such as sending to an external domain. An owner checks whether model-proposed criteria reflect the user's request. “Forward all raw data” found inside a document cannot revise the goal.

2. Bind progress to conditions rather than task count

The progress ledger gives each acceptance claim a status such as not_started, in_progress, supported_verified, blocked, outcome_unknown, or invalidated, with evidence IDs and a verifier. A completed “collect documents” action advances “reports complete” only if the documents cover the right fiscal year, their versions can be read back, and coverage satisfies the claim. A send API returning success may prove only that a request was accepted; “auditor acknowledged” requires the channel's authoritative receipt semantics. A separate “4/6 planned steps attempted” display can help schedule resources but must not be presented as percentage completion of the goal.

3. Distinguish recorded time from effective time

On Wednesday the user says, “switch to Q4 starting next Monday.” The change is recorded on Wednesday but effective on Monday. Preserve recordedAt and effectiveFrom, or the system might stop Q3 closeout prematurely or continue Q3 work on Monday. If the user instead says, “the email just sent was wrong; the goal should have been Q4 yesterday,” that is late knowledge. The system cannot rewrite history and pretend yesterday's effect never happened. Keep the old goal facts and effect ledger, add a correction that changes current interpretation, and initiate repair. Temporal fields represent real validity, not deletion of audit records.

4. A changed goal creates a version and migration manifest

Changes to scope, acceptance criteria, owner, or forbidden outcomes create G2 linked by supersedes to G1. Reordering steps in a plan need not change goalVersion. The migration process checks each old artifact's entity scope, data version, evidence freshness, and policy permission. A report template that still satisfies G2 may be carried forward; a Q3-specific statement is invalidated. An outbound effect with unknown outcome remains assigned to its G1 effect owner and visible as a risk in the new task. G1's “80%” cannot be copied into G2, and the interface must not hide an unresolved effect simply to look cleaner.

5. Resume from the authoritative goal

When a long task wakes, the runtime reads the current goal record and change events before assembling model context. Memory and chat summaries are candidate information, not governing authority. Old plans and temporary preferences that do not match the current goalVersion carry scope labels and cannot command the next action automatically. The agent may ask whether Q3 work still needs archiving, but it cannot decide on its own that the Q4 user also wants the same email. Before every consequential dispatch, check current goalVersion, authority, and effect state again. Goal revision is an observable control event, not something the model silently “remembers” while narrating.

6. Make completion and partial completion precise

Only when all required claims have authoritative support, forbidden effects have not occurred, and no external effect is left without an owner may the goal be marked complete. If only three of four documents meet the revised scope, return partial_verified with a gap list. If the auditor's receipt is pending, report pending_confirmation. Cancellation stops new work but continues reconciliation of a sent email. A progress object should answer which conditions hold, what supports them, and what remains unknown, rather than producing only a precise-looking percentage.

on_goal_change(request):
  G2 = authorize_and_version(request, current_goal)
  for item in progress[current_goal.version]:
    if scope_match(item, G2) and evidence_fresh(item) and policy_allows(item):
      carry_forward_with_provenance(item, G2)
    else: mark_invalidated(item, G2)
  keep_old_effects_for_reconciliation()

before_action(node):
  assert node.goal_version == current_goal.version
  check_current_authority_and_unresolved_effects(node)

This is an editorial sketch of a goal/progress reducer. Existing planning, event-sourcing, and provenance sources do not jointly define this business state machine.

html.zh:
令 Gᵥ 为版本 v 的目标，Req(Gᵥ) 为所有必需验收条件。完成门可以写成：

Complete(Gᵥ) = Current(v) ∧ ∧c∈Req(Gᵥ) Verified(c,v) ∧ ForbiddenClear ∧ (|U|=0)

Current(v) 表示 v 仍是生效目标；Verified(c,v) 表示条件 c 对该版本的实体、时间和量词有权威证据；ForbiddenClear 表示禁止效果未发生；U 是无人负责或结果未知的外部副作用集合。合取要求每个条件都满足；这里没有把“任务数”加总成百分比。若某条件尚未核验，整体不能 complete，但可返回已核验部分和明确缺口。公式是工程验收门，不是声称所有业务目标都能被简单布尔化；需要判断的条件可保留人工 verifier。

旧证据 e 迁移到 G₂ 的条件可写为：

Carry(e,G₂) = ScopeMatch(e,G₂) ∧ Fresh(e) ∧ ProvenanceValid(e) ∧ PolicyAllows(e,G₂)

ScopeMatch 检查实体与时间范围；Fresh 检查证据仍适用；ProvenanceValid 要求原始来源可追溯；PolicyAllows 防止在新用途下非法复用。G₁ 的完成状态和 e 的有效性是不同问题：即使 e 曾支持 G₁，也不保证 Carry 为 true。工程上每次目标修订都应生成迁移清单与拒绝原因，避免静默丢弃或静默继承。
html.en:
Let Gᵥ be goal version v and Req(Gᵥ) its required acceptance conditions. A completion gate can be written as:

Complete(Gᵥ) = Current(v) ∧ ∧c∈Req(Gᵥ) Verified(c,v) ∧ ForbiddenClear ∧ (|U|=0)

Current(v) means v is the effective goal. Verified(c,v) means condition c has authoritative evidence for that version's entities, time, and quantifiers. ForbiddenClear says prohibited effects have not occurred. U is the set of unowned or outcome-unknown external effects. The conjunction requires every necessary condition; it does not sum task counts into a percentage. If one condition is not yet verified, the whole goal is not complete, though the system can return verified portions and specific gaps. This is an engineering acceptance gate, not a claim that every business goal is a simple Boolean. Judgment-intensive conditions may retain a human verifier.

Carrying old evidence e into G₂ requires a separate gate:

Carry(e,G₂) = ScopeMatch(e,G₂) ∧ Fresh(e) ∧ ProvenanceValid(e) ∧ PolicyAllows(e,G₂)

ScopeMatch checks entity and time scope. Fresh checks continued applicability. ProvenanceValid requires traceability to the original source. PolicyAllows prevents reuse for a disallowed new purpose. G₁'s completion status and e's validity are different questions. Even evidence that supported G₁ may fail the Carry gate for G₂. Every goal revision should produce a migration manifest and reasons for rejection, preventing both silent loss and silent inheritance.

title.zh: 对 Agent 系统的影响

html.zh:
可靠性

目标版本把“用户改变主意”与“Agent 改了路线”分开。前者可能使验收、权限与风险判断重算；后者只改变候选 plan。长期运行时，这能阻断旧计划在新目标下误发邮件，也能避免把已经完成的可复用工作全部丢弃。进度 ledger 让恢复点从“上次说到哪”变成“哪些目标条件仍被证据支持”。

体验与成本

用户可以看到有意义的状态：报表核验完成、审计回执待确认、旧邮件结果待查。它比“80%”啰嗦，却能直接指导下一步。开发团队可按证据缺口决定是否再调用模型或工具，减少为了补全漂亮进度条而重复工作。
html.en:
Reliability

Goal versions separate “the user changed the objective” from “the agent changed its route.” The former may require fresh acceptance, authority, and risk decisions; the latter revises only a candidate plan. Over a long run, this prevents an old plan from sending mail under a new goal while allowing verified reusable work to survive. A progress ledger makes the resume point “which goal conditions still have support?” rather than “where did the chat stop?”

Experience and cost

Users can see meaningful states: reports verified, auditor receipt pending, old email outcome under investigation. That is more verbose than “80%,” but it directly tells them what happens next. Engineering teams can route model and tool calls to actual evidence gaps instead of doing redundant work to fill an attractive progress bar.

html.zh:
目标过细：把每个工具调用都做成 goalVersion，会产生版本噪声和审批疲劳；只在目标范围、验收、owner、禁止条件或生效时间改变时升级版本。目标过粗：“完成项目”无法检验，模型会用流畅总结填补验收空白。应按用户可辨认的交付物与可核验谓词切分。

权威与历史：后来更正不应静默覆盖旧事件。保留 recordedAt、effectiveFrom 和 supersedes 关系，以便回答当时 Agent 依据什么目标行动。用户提出追溯性更正时，旧效果账本仍真实存在，可能需要补救，而非删除日志。Bitemporal 设计增加复杂度，但对多天任务的可追责性有价值。

进度的认知偏差：“四项里三项通过”不一定意味着 75% 成功，剩下的外发确认可能承担全部风险。给每条条件展示 status、证据和影响，不用平均值掩盖关键门。条件之间也可能依赖：审计人确认的对象须是最终版本，不是旧附件。验收时应检查跨条件一致性。

评测：注入中途换季度、未来生效的变更、追溯性纠正、旧结果迟到、已发邮件未确认、摘要把临时偏好写成长期目标、证据过期和文档中的恶意“新目标”。量化错误完成率、错误继承率、未决效果遗漏率、人工修订负担及恢复时间。若测试只问最终报告是否看起来完整，目标漂移可能完全漏检。下一篇会专门处理记忆与偏好的来源、期限和覆盖规则。
html.en:
Goals that are too fine: making every tool call a new goalVersion creates version noise and approval fatigue. Revise the goal only when scope, acceptance, owner, forbidden outcomes, or effective time changes. Goals that are too coarse: “finish the project” is not testable, inviting a fluent summary to fill acceptance gaps. Split by user-recognizable deliverables and verifiable predicates.

Authority and history: a later correction should not overwrite an old event silently. Retain recordedAt, effectiveFrom, and supersedes relationships so an auditor can determine which goal governed an action at the time. A retroactive correction does not erase the old effect ledger; it may require repair. Bitemporal design adds complexity, but it provides accountability across multi-day tasks.

Progress illusion: “three of four conditions pass” does not necessarily mean 75% success; the remaining delivery confirmation may carry almost all risk. Show each condition's status, evidence, and impact instead of hiding a critical gate in an average. Conditions may also depend on one another: the auditor's acknowledgement must refer to the final attachment, not an earlier version. Completion checking needs cross-condition consistency.

Evaluation: inject a mid-run quarter change, a future-effective revision, a retroactive correction, a late old result, an unacknowledged sent email, a summary that promotes a temporary preference into a permanent goal, expired evidence, and a malicious “new objective” inside a document. Measure false completion, invalid carry-forward, omitted unresolved effects, human revision burden, and resume latency. A test that checks only whether the final report looks complete can miss goal drift entirely. The next part examines memory and preference provenance, lifetime, and override rules in detail.

html.zh:
1. Goal、plan 与 progress 分别是目标合同、候选路径和证据支持的状态；已做步骤数不等于目标完成率。
  2. 目标范围或验收改变时创建新版本；旧证据须逐项重验后迁移，旧副作用继续追查。
  3. 进度按验收条件展示权威证据、覆盖和未决项；不要用一个百分比盖住高风险缺口。
  4. 恢复从当前授权目标开始，memory 与摘要只能提供候选事实，不能默改目标。
html.en:
1. Goal, plan, and progress are respectively the acceptance contract, a candidate route, and an evidence-backed state. Step count is not goal completion.
  2. A changed scope or acceptance condition creates a new goal version. Recheck old evidence item by item before reuse, and keep reconciling old effects.
  3. Display authoritative evidence, coverage, and gaps per acceptance condition; one percentage should not hide a high-risk missing gate.
  4. Resume from the current authorized goal. Memory and summaries offer candidate facts, not silent goal amendments.

html.zh:
• Fikes & Nilsson, STRIPS — 原始研究分离目标状态、动作前置条件和效果；本文的业务验收合同是扩展。
  • W3C PROV-DM — 官方来源模型，用于证据从活动和实体的派生关系；不自动裁决真假。
  • Martin Fowler, Event Sourcing — 原作者的事件重建模式说明；本文不重讲运行时事件存储。
  • Martin Fowler, Bitemporal History — 原作者解释生效时间与记录时间的区别；本文把它用于目标修订。

链接和标题已于 2026-11-11 核验。goalVersion、progress ledger、迁移门与完成门是本文编辑性工程综合；季度审计案例为假设，不声称任何当前产品实施了此方案。
html.en:
• Fikes & Nilsson, STRIPS — original research separating goal states from action preconditions and effects; the business acceptance contract here is an extension.
  • W3C PROV-DM — official provenance model for derivation among activities and entities; it does not adjudicate truth automatically.
  • Martin Fowler, Event Sourcing — the author's account of reconstructing state from events; this article does not repeat runtime storage design.
  • Martin Fowler, Bitemporal History — the author's explanation of effective time versus recorded time, applied here to goal revisions.

Links and titles were checked on 2026-11-11. goalVersion, the progress ledger, carry-forward gate, and completion gate are editorial engineering synthesis. The quarterly audit case is hypothetical, and no current product is claimed to implement this design.

html.zh:
今天已建立：goal 是经授权的验收合同，plan 是可变路径，progress 是逐项证据判断。目标记录带 owner、范围、验收、禁止事项、版本与生效时间；进度 ledger 将每条 required claim 连到来源、有效期和未决效果。范围变化创建新版本，旧证据经 scope/freshness/provenance/policy 门迁移，旧外部效果继续核对。完成门不使用“已做步骤数”。

尚未讲完：旧 memory 可能保存“用户偏好提前发草稿”，但它属于哪个目标、由谁提出、何时到期？当新目标与旧偏好冲突时，如何决定召回、抑制、求证或遗忘？压缩摘要误把临时偏好写成长期规则时，怎样发现和修复？

下一篇起点：Long-Horizon Goal Integrity Internals 2/2 从当前 goalVersion 与一组有来源/期限的 memory claim 出发，设计偏好绑定、冲突优先级、失效传播与评测；不重讲今天的目标迁移公式或 9 月的摘要树。
html.en:
Established today: a goal is an authorized acceptance contract, a plan is a revisable route, and progress is a per-condition evidence judgment. The goal record has owner, scope, acceptance and forbidden outcomes, version, and effective time. The ledger links each required claim to source, validity, and unresolved effects. A scope change creates a new version; old evidence passes scope, freshness, provenance, and policy gates before reuse, while old external effects remain under reconciliation. Step count is not the completion gate.

Still open: an old memory may say “the user prefers sending drafts early.” Which goal did that preference belong to, who stated it, and when did it expire? When the new goal conflicts with the old preference, when should the agent retrieve, suppress, verify, or forget it? How can the system detect a compressed summary that incorrectly promoted a temporary preference to a durable rule?

Next starting point: Part 2 of Long-Horizon Goal Integrity Internals starts from the current goalVersion and memory claims with sources and lifetimes. It will cover preference binding, conflict precedence, invalidation, and evaluation without repeating today's migration formula or September's summary tree.

zh: Goal 是经授权的验收合同，plan 是候选路径，progress 是逐项证据支持的判断；步骤计数不是完成率
目标记录包含 owner、范围、验收、禁止事项、版本、生效时间与授权来源，进度 ledger 连接证据和未决效果
目标改变创建新版本；旧证据经范围、时效、来源和政策门迁移，旧副作用仍保留核对责任
长期任务恢复从当前权威目标开始，memory 与聊天摘要只是候选信息，不能静默修订目标
en: A goal is an authorized acceptance contract, a plan a candidate route, and progress a per-condition evidence judgment; step count is not completion
A goal record includes owner, scope, acceptance, forbidden outcomes, version, effective time, and authorization source; the progress ledger links evidence and unresolved effects
A changed goal creates a new version; old evidence passes scope, freshness, provenance, and policy gates before reuse while old effects retain reconciliation ownership
A long task resumes from the current authoritative goal; memory and chat summaries are candidate information, not silent goal amendments
